_comment: php2shell offset database. Each entry pins the offsets for ONE libphp.so build. 'build_id' (GNU build-id) and 'sha256' are exact keys you can match even against a STRIPPED target, as long as you have a copy of its libphp.so (same distro package == same build_id). 'php_version'+'source' are the fuzzy key used by --php wordlist mode. zif/dtor are in-file symbol offsets; htdata is the Zend-MM chunk-relative offset (tracks the build's heap layout). verified=true means a full RCE was observed on this exact build.

entries.note: zif/dtor from ddebs dbgsym (build-id verified); htdata guessed, sweep to confirm.
8.2 is OOM-vulnerable (scanner flags it) but this RCE grooming chain does not land on 8.2; htdata not profiled.
